title: Longest Substring Without Repeating Characters
description:
Given a string `s`, return the length of the **longest substring** that contains no repeated characters.

A substring is a contiguous run of characters.

examples.explanation: "wke" works; "pwke" is a subsequence, not a substring.

constraints: s consists of English letters, digits, symbols and spaces.
hints: Slide a window over the string; when a character repeats, move the left edge past its previous occurrence.
Store the last index of each character in a map so the left edge can jump directly.
